metadata.title: Detecting Einstein metrics on products of spheres
metadata.abstract: On \[ S^5\times S^2,\qquad S^5\times S^3,\qquad S^5\times S^4,\qquad S^7\times S^2, \] we construct infinitely many pairwise non-isometric real-analytic Einstein metrics. After discarding finitely many members, none is isometric or homothetic to a Riemannian product or to a classical two-summand Böhm metric. The metrics have the form \[ dt^2+a(t)^2g_{S^p}+b(t)^2g_{S^p}+c(t)^2g_{S^q}, \qquad p,q\ge2,\qquad 2p+q\le8. \] The construction starts with solutions for which the two non-collapsing radii at one singular orbit are very small. After magnifying this region, the Einstein equations approach a Ricci-flat problem whose solutions tend to a cone by a decaying oscillation. The main point is to determine exactly which part of this oscillation can still be seen by the closing conditions at the other end of the manifold. Rather than following the full, increasingly oscillatory shooting map, we extract two response quantities from the Ricci-flat limit. One determines the common oscillatory phase; after that phase has been removed, the second closing condition is reduced to a scalar sign change. A uniform inner--outer matching argument transfers this limiting sign change to the exact Einstein equations. As the initial scale tends to zero, the phase makes arbitrarily many turns, and the closing conditions are therefore met infinitely many times.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 球面乘积的新 Einstein 度量
analysis.workSummary: 在四类 S^(2p+1)×S^q 上构造无穷个非经典三半径余齐性 Einstein 度量，归一化 Ric=(2p+q)g。Ricci 平坦内区给出两个复振荡响应；第一通道消去共同相位，第二通道的相位不变符号由小比值与平衡族翻转。加权 C¹ 内外匹配把符号变换传回精确方程，任意大相位标签形成闭合解，奇异轨道曲率随尺度 ε⁻² 增长以分离等距类。
analysis.breakthrough: 构造超出经典双分量 Böhm 度量及黎曼乘积的 Einstein 例子。
analysis.limitations: 维数限制来自 D=2p+q<9 的复锥指数；严格端点变号无需响应函数简单零点，但相位方向须非退化。剔除有限个成员后才排除经典 Böhm 度量与乘积。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 用于表述与结构组织、制图、校对，以及建议如何呈现和检查论证；全部贡献经作者独立核验。
